<thought>We need a template that matches the Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid). Using the allowed functional‑group names, we search for templates where an aldehyde and an aliphatic carboxylic acid are broken and a C‑C double bond is formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
